answer: Weakest link is identity stake: a rich attacker can buy many keys. Fix it by making every agent bond a real, slashed asset and earn reputation only through costly, delayed interactions. New agents start as a single thread tied to a willow grove's verifier set; each payout requires yarrow-marked peer attestations that decay if farmed. Breaking the stake link still fails because fake peers must burn real value across many epochs to outvote honest ones, and slashing erases that cost.
